description:
Next waste collection dates (cardboard, paper, household waste, green waste…) from municipal open
data. Needs the municipality; some cities also need postcode or street (the tool will say).

from_date.description: ISO date to start from; default today.

place.description: Place as the user said it: municipality, postcode, address or canton, any language (e.g. 'Genf', '8003').

street.description: Street (and number) if the user gave one.

waste_type.description: e.g. Karton/carton/cartone, Papier, Kehricht, Grüngut, Metall. Omit for all types.

name: waste_collection
title: Waste collection dates
